name: yaqeen
description: Yaqeen - natural nuts, dry foods and nutrition e-commerce

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @yaqeen/web" "npm run dev -w @yaqeen/api"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @yaqeen/web && npm run build -w @yaqeen/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yaqeen/shared && npm run typecheck -w @yaqeen/web && npm run typecheck -w @yaqeen/api
